methodology: A multi-stage method involving color image improvement of the retina, applying the Gabor filter on the green channel, segmenting the green channel using U-Net++, extracting HOG and LBP features from binary images, and disease diagnosis using a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN).
key_findings: Achieved accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and F1-score of 98.9%, 94.1%, 98.8%, and 85.26% (with another reported accuracy/metric value of 98.14%) on the DRIVE dataset, and accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity of 98.6%, 99%, and 98% on the MESSIDOR dataset, outperforming manual approaches by skilled ophthalmologists.
